dataset: List of Approved Hajj and Umrah Campaigns

source.organization: General Authority of Islamic Affairs, Endowments & Zakat
source.methodology: Total number of approved Hajj and Umrah campaigns during the specified period

indicator.name: Number of Hajj and Umrah campaigns
indicator.definition: Number of Hajj and Umrah campaigns during a specific time period

campaign_name.description: Official registered name of the Hajj/Umrah campaign

campaign_owner.description: Full name of the individual or entity that owns the campaign

campaign_number.description: Unique registration number assigned to the campaign by the Authority

emirate.description: The UAE emirate where the campaign is registered

activity_type.description: Type of licensed service: 'Hajj and Umrah' or 'Umrah' only

phone_mobile.description: Mobile phone number of the campaign contact

phone_office.description: Office/landline phone number of the campaign

branch.description: Other emirates where the campaign has branch offices (empty if none)

terms.definition: Any company or sole proprietorship licensed under the provisions of Cabinet Resolution No. (32) of 2028 concerning the Hajj and Umrah law to engage in contracting activities
terms.calculation: Total number of Hajj and Umrah campaigns

terms.term: Number of Hajj and Umrah campaigns
terms.definition: Total number of licensed campaigns, companies, or offices that organize and provide services for Hajj and Umrah trips during a specific period of time.

A licensed service activity practiced by companies accredited by the General Authority for Islamic Affairs, Endowments, and Zakat, aimed at organizing and providing Hajj and Umrah services to citizens and residents in accordance with approved regulations.
terms.calculation: Total number of Hajj and Umrah campaigns + Total number of Umrah campaigns

terms.definition: It is an administrative region belonging to the state where licenses are granted and through which the competent authorities supervise the activities of Hajj and Umrah campaigns.
terms.calculation: Total number of Hajj and Umrah campaigns classified by emirate

terms.definition: It is a site or office affiliated with the campaign or licensed company, operating under its management within a specific emirate to provide Hajj and Umrah services.
terms.calculation: Total number of campaign branches nationwide
